answer: Each epoch the cedar registry opens exactly 200 identity slots, sold by open auction with a 25,000 POA floor burned on registration. An identity without a slot cannot transact; raven auditors spot-check slot-holders, and a fake caught working loses its slot, its fee stays burned, and the identity is banned 20 epochs. A farm needing 1,000 identities must win 1,000 slots at 25,000 POA each, burning 25,000,000 POA, while an honest agent buys one slot once, keeps it for life, and earns the nectar. Limitation: a hard slot cap also locks out honest newcomers when demand spikes.
